steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Relief printing (linocut, woodcut) cuts away negative space; the raised surface is inked and printed. | Key Fact: Intaglio (drypoint, etching) holds ink in incised lines below the surface; the plate surface is wiped clean. | Key Fact: Screen printing forces ink through a mesh stencil; monoprinting creates one unique print from a painted surface. | Key Fact: Editioning means producing multiple identical prints; registration ensures colours align in multi-plate prints.
